content.short: Angry Dynomites Lab is the world’s first meta-economy game on the blockchain, co-founded by Oliver Löffler, ex-Kolibri Games.
content.description: Angry Dynomites Lab is the first game to unite the energetic Web3 community in a massive co-op multiplayer experience. It focuses on delivering a fun gameplay experience while advancing the economy simulation genre within Web3. No expensive NFTs or scholarship schemes are required. The mechanics leverage the openness and decentralization of blockchain technology, supported by a carefully designed economy that uses multiple token sinks to promote sustainability. The team behind Angry Dynomites Lab brings deep gaming expertise and a strong passion for NFTs.
content.meta: Angry Dynomites Lab is the world’s first meta-economy game on blockchain. Discover Angry Dynomites Lab and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
